metadata.description:
The Bodo tribe of Assam brings you a delicious and healthy twist to chicken cooking! In this special episode of The Tribal Kitchen, we explore a traditional Bodo chicken recipe that’s creamier than butter chicken — yet surprisingly light and heart-friendly. Cooked with forest herbs instead of garam masala, this dish blends rich flavor with natural goodness. Discover how the Bodo community turns simple, local ingredients into a culinary delight that’s both comforting and wholesome.
Join us on this flavorful journey through the Bodo kitchens of Assam — where tradition meets taste and wellness!
